notes: Empty-array document. There is no item table at all — the work is described in a narrative paragraph and billed as one figure. Correct label is [] ("the document itemises nothing"), never null ("no such field exists"). Watch for the model inventing a single line item, e.g. {Professional legal services, qty 1, 4200.00}: that is structurally plausible, will come back with high confidence, and is a hallucination — the number 4200.00 is nowhere on the page. Also exercises the ampersand rule: vendor is 'Harbour & Fell Legal', not 'Harbour and Fell Legal', and the ALL-CAPS letterhead is title-cased. GST of 420.00 is stated but there is no subtotal row, so the Week 2 check has only total and stated GST to work with.
